info.name: Amazon SageMaker API
info.description:
Amazon SageMaker is a fully managed machine learning platform that enables developers and data scientists to build, train, and deploy machine learning models at scale. This API provides programmatic access to SageMaker resources including notebook instances, training jobs, models, and endpoints.

Contact Support:
 Name: Amazon Web Services
